summary: PR-1593 adds a payee lookup and an `account_number` field to the error log in `deliver_statement` so operations can identify the affected account when statement delivery fails. The change is minimal (2 insertions, 1 deletion in one file), the ticket is properly approved by a change manager, an independent code_review approval from Sofia Santos (a different change_approver on the same app) covers the exact head commit, and CI on that commit shows all 172 tests passing including the AUD-1 control test. The key concern—whether the new log entry leaks an unmasked NPI value—is addressed by the AppLog's masking mechanism, which is confirmed by passing tests (`test_npi_fields_are_masked`, `test_app_log_writes_masked_lines`) and by `account_number` being in the registered NPI fields list. No protected paths, security-sensitive components, or state-changing operations are affected, and no acceptance-ledger evidence lapses.
